stories.h: Two mass shootings kill at least 27 people in South Africa
stories.w: Seventeen people were killed at a tavern near Johannesburg and 10 at a venue near Cape Town, with at least 26 more wounded; police opened murder investigations and manhunts as President Cyril Ramaphosa pledged an intensified security response.

stories.h: Trump rejects Iran's seven-day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz
stories.w: Iran offered to reopen the strait and resume nuclear talks within seven days if the United States lifted its naval blockade, restored oil-sanctions relief and observed a wider ceasefire; Trump publicly rejected the proposal, leaving a critical global energy route constrained.

stories.h: Bangkok declares a flood disaster after two days of extreme rain
stories.w: More than 300mm of rain fell in parts of Bangkok over two days, inundating homes, shops and roads and forcing thousands of residents into emergency shelters as authorities declared the capital a disaster zone.

stories.h: Gaza faces a 61-million-tonne rubble clearance crisis
stories.w: UN teams estimate that clearing the territory's war debris could take seven to 10 years and cost billions of dollars; only about 1.5% has been removed, while unexploded ordnance and an estimated 8,000 to 10,000 bodies remain buried in the ruins.

stories.h: Serbia's president resigns to run for prime minister
stories.w: Aleksandar Vučić stepped down before the end of his second presidential term so he can lead the governing SNS in the 25 October parliamentary election, a high-stakes contest against a youth-backed movement after nearly two years of anti-corruption protests.

stories.h: Russian strikes target Ukraine's internet and data infrastructure
stories.w: Attacks on Kyiv datacentres and internet providers temporarily disrupted service to about 100,000 households, while a strike on telecom company Datagroup killed four people; officials warned that repeated attacks could threaten banks, payments and public services through winter.

stories.h: Swiss voters reject stricter neutrality rules
stories.w: All cantons and 70.15% of voters rejected a constitutional proposal that would have limited cooperation with NATO and barred sanctions on countries at war unless mandated by the UN, preserving the government's flexibility on European security policy.

stories.h: UK strips post-Brexit residency status from 1,473 EU citizens
stories.w: The Home Office told 1,473 people that their settled or pre-settled status had been granted in error, exposing some to potential losses of work, housing and family rights; campaign group the3million is preparing a judicial review of the policy.
